Name: Custom Hay
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
Vanilla hay drop chances are not truly random and for some people it seems that they never get hay because of it.

This mod makes the hay drop chance for each grass cutting action truly random. By default this means there's a true 50% chance of getting hay with an ordinary scythe and a true 75% chance with the golden scythe.

You can set custom chances for each in the config.


[size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
